ai_summary: Greenply Industries' board approved the appointment of an experienced independent director to bolster corporate governance and the amalgamation of two wholly-owned Singaporean subsidiaries to streamline overseas operations and reduce costs. The most significant action is the reclassification of several promoter group members, who currently hold zero shares, to public shareholders. While this largely formalizes a prior divestment, it could subtly indicate a broader shift in ownership dynamics or promoter involvement, warranting observation of future promoter shareholding levels.
